newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 1.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:

* Showtime Event Television, likely aware that Saturday night's bite-shortened championship fight between Evander Holyfield and Mike Tyson set a record for pay-per-view buys and revenue, was readying to give Tyson another chance.
* Viacom Inc and Seagram Co Ltd offered competing plans in court for their USA Network.
* Actor Rupert Everett was near a deal with Walt Disney Co's Touchstone to star, for a third time, with Julia Roberts in "Martha and Arthur."
* Witt-Thomas Productions President Gary Levine has joined Time Warner's Warner Bros. TV as executive vice president of creative affairs.
* The soundtrack to "Space Jam," and discs from the Wallflowers, Spice Girls, Jewel and LeAnn Rimes were the top sellers for the first half of 1997.
* The concert industry posted a strong midyear in contrast to a disappointing 1996.
